LZMA SDK 24.09 (LzmaDec.c, Igor Pavlov), linked into predator.exe to read the disc's archives.
The LZMA SDK is placed in the public domain (https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html): anyone is free to copy, modify,
publish, use, compile, sell, or distribute the original LZMA SDK code, either in source code form or as a compiled
binary, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, and by any means.
